lesson.title: Write prompts like a brief, not a search
body: AI tools respond to the brief you give them. A search-style prompt ('marketing email ideas') gets a generic answer because the tool has to guess who it's for, what good looks like and how you want it laid out.

Give it three things. Role: who it should act as ('You're a B2B email marketer'). Context: the audience, goal and constraints ('for SharePoint admins, launching a new template, under 120 words, UK English'). Format: exactly what to return ('three subject lines, then one email body, then a one-line CTA').

Then iterate in the same chat rather than starting again: 'make option 2 punchier', 'cut the jargon'. The tool keeps the context, so each round gets closer. If you find yourself repeating instructions, save the brief as a reusable template.
lesson.takeaway: Role + context + format, then refine in the same conversation.

m365.title: Stop flows failing silently with 'Configure run after'
m365.what: By default a Power Automate flow just stops when a step fails. 'Configure run after' lets a step run only when the previous one has failed or timed out, so you can catch problems and get told about them.
try: Open a flow you rely on and add a new action after the step most likely to fail, e.g. 'Send an email (V2)' or a Teams 'Post message'.
On the new action, open the … menu and choose 'Configure run after'.
Untick 'is successful' and tick 'has failed' and 'has timed out', then save.
Put the flow name and a link to the run history in the message so you can jump straight to the failure.

explainer.story: The Bank of England raised interest rates to 4%
bullets: On 5 November the Bank raised Bank Rate from 3.75% to 4%, its first increase since August 2023. Eight of the nine committee members voted for the rise.
The reason is inflation. Rising energy and fuel prices pushed CPI up to 3.6% in October, and the Bank's forecasts show inflation climbing towards about 5% by the middle of next year.
Higher rates make borrowing more expensive to cool spending. Tracker and variable mortgages move quickly; fixed deals change when they're renewed. The next decision is on 17 December.
explainer.why: It affects mortgage renewals, savings rates and the wider economy heading into 2027.

term.meaning: One hundredth of a percentage point (0.01%). Markets use it to avoid confusion: '25 basis points' is clearer than 'a quarter of a percent'.
term.example: The Bank of England's rise from 3.75% to 4% was 25 basis points.
